title: Component management
subtitle: Configure runtime components, check connections, and use orchestration, tasks, provenance, memory, evaluation and evolution in one workbench.
saved: Configuration saved. Check the connection again to confirm availability.
saveError: Could not save the configuration. Refresh and try again.
loadError: Could not load component information. Try again.
checkError: Connection check failed. Verify the service and its configuration, then retry.
permissionDenied: Your component management permission has changed. Refresh or sign in again.
adminOnly: Connection configuration and checks require a system administrator. Tenant administration is a separate permission.
offline: The server is disconnected. You can still edit this device's workflow. Sign in and connect to use server operations and connection checks.
selectScope: Select a tenant and private space before using task-related component features.
noTask: This space has no tasks. Create a workflow and a task first.
selectTaskPlaceholder: Select a task to operate on
taskHint: Provenance, memory, evaluation and evolution apply only to the selected task. Tasks from other spaces are never selected automatically.
viewerHint: Your tenant role is read-only. Ask a tenant administrator for permission to execute operations.
configurationHint: System administrators manage these settings. Changes affect subsequent calls from this server and are not copied into personal offline configurations.
temporalWorkerHint: After changing the Temporal connection, namespace or task queue, restart the separate worker and check the connection again. Saving settings does not restart the worker.
secretHint: Credentials are never displayed. Leave blank to retain the current value; enter a new value to replace it.
secretPlaceholder: Leave blank to keep the current credential
clearSecretHint: The credential will be removed when you save
projectHint: Read live data from the project bound to this tenant. Every operation is read-only. The server supplies the project identity, so another tenant's project cannot be selected.
projectBindingPermission: Binding a project requires both system administrator and tenant owner or administrator permissions. Tenant members can use read operations.
projectIdPlaceholder: Enter a project ID, or clear and save to remove the binding
projectSaveFirst: The binding has unsaved changes. Save first to read from the confirmed project.
projectConflict: Another administrator changed this binding. Close and reopen this dialog to load the latest revision.
projectRequired: No project is bound. Contact an administrator with both system and tenant management permissions.
projectReadError: Could not read the project. Check the binding, connection configuration and service availability.
noFields: Use the dedicated management features within the workbench. This component needs no separate connection configuration.

details.disabled: A system administrator has disabled this component.
details.configuration_required: A system administrator must complete the runtime configuration.
details.not_checked: Configuration is ready; a live check has not been run.
details.check_passed: The most recent live check passed.
details.check_failed: The most recent live check failed. Review the dependencies and services.

octop.description: Manage tenants, agents, models, skills, tools and storage through the shared entry point for all components.
octop.capability: Local runtime · Multiple tenants · Configuration sync

semantica.description: Write execution records to independent provenance storage and read them back to verify traceable execution evidence.

beatdesign.description: Import multi-skill, multi-agent canvas designs as executable workflows with offline preview and editing.
beatdesign.capability: Canvas import · DAG orchestration · Local editing

commerceagentbench.description: Import real benchmark results to assess task completion, constraints and execution quality over long runs.

rna.description: Generate and audit evolution candidates from evaluation results and execution evidence within a controlled improvement process.

hindsight.description: Retain, recall and delete memories isolated by tenant and task, making experience useful for later work.

temporal.description: Run durable long-running workflows with recovery, pause, resume and heartbeat leases.
